# ANALYSIS: BASE_ENGINE_STAGE1_BACKTEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We ran the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder harness on the base engine (no candidate changes) to compute edge_capture on OP-16 anchors, aggregate Sharpe, and to generate OOS walk-forward and real-fills validation on the top-3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). The base engine serves as the control for evaluating any candidate strategy.

## Mechanism

The backtest used the autorsearch grinder harness with the base engine configuration over the available data window (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). The engine_pnl_on_J_winners and engine_loss_on_J_losers were computed directly from the simulator output for each of the six J anchor days. Aggregate Sharpe was calculated from the full equity curve. OOS walk-forward validation used a 70/30 time-based split (train: 2025-01-02 to 2025-09-30, test: 2025-10-01 to 2026-06-18). Real-fills validation re-ran the top-3 J days through the realistic OPRA simulator (cached bid/ask, slippage model) and compared to BS-sim results.
